hero.title: Tether adds $10 million in Bitdeer stock after holding through an 87% drop
hero.description: The purchase increased Tether's total holding by nearly 10% to 41.45 million shares, while its Class A voting stake dropped to 17.9% due to share dilution.

latest.title: The Iran war could shatter rising expectations of surplus oil supply in coming months

latest.title: Russia Is Turning Pigeons Into Cyborg Drones—and You Can Now Hire Them
latest.description: A Russian neurotechnology company is taking commercial orders for brain-implanted pigeons that it says can follow remote commands and fly for more than 10 hours.

latest.title: AI data center boom strains construction labor across the U.S.
latest.description: CNBC traveled to Abilene, Texas to see how the AI data center construction boom is impacting the local economy in both positive and negative ways.

latest.title: Bybit’s $1.4 billion hack postmortem is ready. You won’t get to see it.
latest.description: Bybit’s public account still rests on preliminary 2025 forensic reports. Chief Technology Officer Rockman Zhang said more detail could help attackers like those who hit Binance.

latest.title: Billions on the line for Berkshire utility as Oregon's high court reviews wildfire claims
latest.description: Berkshire Hathaway's PacifiCorp and attorneys for thousands of plaintiffs are welcoming a decision by Oregon's Supreme Court to widen its review of a 2023 lower court trial in which a jury awarded more than one billion in damages over four wildfires in 2020.

latest.title: The doctor, the patient and the smartwatch: What physicians think of the third voice at your appointment
latest.description: Many Americans use a smartwatch or fitness tracker to collect their health data, and doctors say the devices are increasingly becoming part of annual checkups.

latest.title: ASEAN+3 agrees on initiative to explore crypto payments cooperation
latest.description: A working group will examine enhancing connectivity between domestic digital payment networks and bringing their regulations into more alignment.

latest.title: Trump-linked crypto token WLFI plunges 50% to record lows

latest.title: Binance plans Asia hub in Bhutan, receives preliminary approval
latest.description: The agreement is a milestone in Binance’s effort to expand its presence in Bhutan since launching a national crypto-powered tourism payment system in 2025.

latest.title: Saudi Arabia shifts Vision 2030 spending amid economic and security pressure
latest.description: The Kingdom is moving from "spending and delivery at any cost" to "spending and delivery at the right cost," Economic Minister Faisal Alibrahim told CNBC.

latest.title: Africa’s richest man is taking his mega-refinery public in a blockbuster IPO
latest.description: Dangote Refinery’s IPO could value the company at about $47 billion, in what is expected to be Africa’s biggest stock market listing.

latest.title: Inflation has shoppers hunting for value. That bodes well for Black Friday
latest.description: Even as consumers face macroeconomic headwinds, retailers are expecting robust holiday spending through Black Friday and beyond.

latest.title: OpenAI Turns the Tables on Apple With Its Own Trade-Secret Theft Claims

latest.title: Franklin Templeton makes room for HYPE in crypto index ETF
latest.description: The addition comes as US spot investment products tracking Hyperliquid’s native token reach $266.5 million in assets under management.

latest.title: Could AI Break Bitcoin? Not Yet, Research Firm K33 Says
latest.description: A draft AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis renewed worries about the math securing Bitcoin, but K33 says no cryptographic compromise has been demonstrated.
